name: @ailearn/desktop
description: AI Learn — cross-platform Electron desktop launcher (frontend lifecycle only)
author: AI Learn Team

scripts.prebuild:web: cd ../../apps/web && npm install && NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANION_PET_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_QUESTION_FIRST_UI_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_AI_QUESTION_V1_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_RUBRIC_EVALUATION_V1_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANION_V2_INTERNAL=true NEXT_PUBLIC_CARD_SET_DECK_UI_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_AGENT_ACTIVITY_STREAM_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_REVIEW_VOICE_ENTRY_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_LEARNING_RUN_V1=true NEXT_PUBLIC_STAR_MAP_ACTION_V1=true NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANION_JOURNEY_V2=true NEXT_PUBLIC_COMPANION_SHELL_ENABLED=true NEXT_PUBLIC_CARD_GENERATION_V2_ENABLED=true npm run build && mkdir -p .next/standalone/apps/web/.next && cp -r .next/static .next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -r public .next/standalone/apps/web/public
scripts.pack: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:linux: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --dir
scripts.pack:win: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --dir
scripts.dist: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:universal: npm run prebuild:web && npm run build && electron-builder --universal
